customManagers.description: Update Makefile tool versions via inline renovate comments. Accepts datasource + depName, plus any subset of packageName/versioning/extractVersion/registryUrl in that order on the annotation line. .mise.toml is handled by the native `mise` manager — do not add it here (would duplicate every dep).

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before automerging major updates

Group the Java toolchain bump (the mise `java` pin in .mise.toml, the single source of truth). NOTE: pom.xml <java.version>/<maven.compiler.{source,target}> are literal properties the maven manager does not track, and .java-version is tracked by no manager — on a Java major both must be bumped by hand. `make check-java-alignment` (first prerequisite of static-check) fails CI until all four agree, so a mise-only Java bump cannot silently land mismatched.
Group GitHub Actions into one PR
Group Makefile inline `# renovate:` tool versions into a single PR

Group the local KinD cluster stack so it bumps as a unit: kind + kubectl (mise manager) and the kindest/node image (Makefile custom.regex) are version-locked to the Kubernetes minor. A split bump — e.g. kubectl without the matching node image, or kind without the node image built for its release — would create cluster↔kubectl skew >1 minor or a kind/node mismatch; grouping makes them one PR that passes/fails `make e2e` together. Placed AFTER 'Makefile tools' so it wins the groupName for kindest/node (last-match-wins), and pulls kind+kubectl out of their default ungrouped state. cloud-provider-kind is intentionally excluded — it versions independently of the K8s minor.

Disable digest pinning for Makefile-tracked docker dev tools (plantuml, mermaid-cli, cloud-provider-kind). The `docker:pinDigests` preset (from config:best-practices) otherwise generates a `pinDigest` update that collides with the version bump on the `renovate/makefile-tools` branch and silently suppresses the bump. Makefile-tracked deps are dev/lint tools, not production runtime — tag pinning is sufficient. Production-runtime docker pins (k8s `image:` fields) keep their digest pins via the same preset.
